summary: NNN REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its existing credit agreements. The company exercised a $200 million incremental term loan option under its senior unsecured term loan facility, increasing the facility to $500 million. It also entered into a $100 million forward-starting swap fixing SOFR at 3.43% through February 15, 2029. Additionally, pricing grid amendments reduced borrowing margins. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt facility expansion and repricing, not a special situation.
